core_obligations: Reduce to Y = X and then, via Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-decompose, to the case where the normal sheaf of the regular closed immersion Z -> X is identified with the conormal sheaf (proof lines 12087-12104).
Trace the definition of the class and compute C cap [X]_n as i_infinity^*[W]_{n+1} = [W_infinity]_n, then restrict to C_Z X (proof lines 12106-12118).

Use that the conormal sheaf algebra of a regular immersion is the symmetric algebra to identify N = C_Z X with the vector bundle of the conormal sheaf, so that p^*[Z]_{n - r} = [C_Z X]_n (proof lines 12120-12125).
proof_roadmap: Two reductions to the regular immersion case with identified sheaves (proof lines 12087-12104).
Computation of C cap [X]_n via the blowing up (proof lines 12106-12118).
The vector bundle identification and conclusion (proof lines 12120-12125).
difficulty_reason: In the situation described just above the lemma, assuming dim_delta(Y) = n and that the conormal sheaf of Y x_X Z in Z has constant rank r, the lemma asserts c(Z -> X, N) cap [Y]_n = c_top(E) cap [Z x_X Y]_{n - r} in CH_*(Z x_X Y), where c_top(E) is the bivariant class of Remark labelled remark-top-chern-class (statement lines 12075-12085). The proof first uses Lemma labelled lemma-construction-gysin to replace X by Y, so that Z -> X becomes a regular closed immersion of codimension r with dim_delta(X) = n and the goal becomes c(Z -> X, N) cap [X]_n = c_top(E) cap [Z]_{n - r} (proof lines 12087-12095). Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-decompose then reduces further to the case where the normal sheaf and the conormal sheaf are identified, so it suffices to show c(Z -> X, C_{Z/X}^vee) cap [X]_n = [Z]_{n - r} (proof lines 12097-12104). The proof traces the definition of the class: with b : W -> P^1_X the blowing up of infinity(Z), the class C cap [X]_n equals i_infinity^*[W]_{n+1} because the restriction of [W]_{n+1} to A^1_X is the flat pullback of [X]_n, and since W_infinity is an effective Cartier divisor this is [W_infinity]_n by Lemma labelled lemma-easy-gysin; restricting to the open C_Z X inside W_infinity gives [C_Z X]_n (proof lines 12106-12118). Regularity of the embedding makes the conormal sheaf algebra the symmetric algebra by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-quasi-regular-immersion, so p : N = C_Z X -> Z is the structure morphism of the vector bundle of the finite locally free conormal sheaf of rank r, whence p^*[Z]_{n - r} = [C_Z X]_n and the proof is complete (proof lines 12120-12125). Tracing the definition of the localized class through the blowing up and identifying the normal cone with the total space of a vector bundle is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
